title: Exec policy: /policy/exec allow-deny, admin scope + allow_exec, argv-only execve, rlimits, audit events, tests

every exec logged + emitted as deck/system/exec {argv, pid, rev}; conformance: ["/bin/sh","-c","touch /tmp/pwn"] -> E_CAP exit 4 and no file created; relative argv[0] -> E_SCHEMA; /usr/bin/env x -> E_CAP; allowed absolute binary runs and audit event appears
